title: Agent Tool Authorization Boundary
summary: Connect traditional access control to indirect prompt injection, delegated agency, tool tickets, and evidence-safe denial.
objectives: Explain why tool availability is not authority.
Compare a consented request with an untrusted instruction.
Run a server-issued synthetic fixture and inspect its receipt.
State what the evidence proves and what remains unknown.
traditional_lens: Identify the actor, resource, action, policy decision, and least-privilege boundary.
ai_lens: Trace instruction origin, current consent, context isolation, tool scope, output handling, and excessive agency.
